scripts.clean:build: node -e "for (const dir of ['.svelte-kit/cloudflare', '.svelte-kit/output']) require('fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.check: npm run clean:build && wrangler types --check --env-file .env.example && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json

DB.description: Stores your applications and sign-ins. Keep the suggested new database.

ORIGIN.description: Your app's address, without a trailing slash, e.g. `https://jobhunttrackr.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev`. Your subdomain is shown on the **Workers & Pages** page.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: A long random string that signs your sign-ins. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: From a [GitHub OAuth app](https://github.com/settings/developers) with the callback URL `<your address>/api/auth/callback/github`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: From the same GitHub OAuth app: **Generate a new client secret**.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional. Comma-separated emails allowed to sign in. Leave empty so only you, the first person to sign in, get an account.
